snippet.title: Let's Play GBA 929: Inukko Club Fukumaru no Bouken (J)
snippet.description: Uh... so, it's an adventure game clearly. But I don't understand how to start my quest. I'm clearly supposed to run around collecting items and giving it to different people so I can continue my quest to get the hat... but I don't seem to be able to leave these 2 screens.
